Designed for enthusiasts and collectors alike, the S.H. Figuarts Banquet Set includes interchangeable parts and accessories that enhance play and display options. While not a traditional cosmetic product, this figure set adds a touch of fun and creativity to your collection, perfect for showcasing your passion.

Details

• Format: Figure

• Net contents: 14.22 x 3.81 x 34.04 cm | 226.8 g

• Manufacturer: Tamashii Nations

Features

  • Includes barrels, wooden box, complete cutlery set, set of keg steins, and background sheets for scene recreation
  • Features interchangeable facial expression parts and replacement wrist parts for dynamic posing
  • Compatible with S.H.Figuarts Adventure Dawn of Drum Island series characters sold separately
  • Crafted from Polyvinyl Chloride, Acrylonitrile Butadiene Styrene materials for durability and detail

How to use

Carefully assemble and arrange the figure and accessories to recreate the banquet scene from the anime. Use the interchangeable parts to customize expressions and poses. Display in a safe place to enjoy the detailed craftsmanship daily.

Care instructions

Keep the figure in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight to preserve colors and material quality. Avoid exposure to heat or moisture which may cause deformation. Handle with care to prevent damage to small parts and accessories.
